interpretation.demand: Zonal RT_Demand measures wholesale settlement demand in MW, from metering, and includes grossed-up demand response during this study period. System_Load is a distinct planning/reporting series, not used as the target.
interpretation.date: Supplied local calendar date; hour labels are hour-ending 01 to 24.
interpretation.dst: The published March HE02 averages HE01 and HE03. The two physical November HE02 observations are averaged into one published row.
interpretation.weather: Official Notes station mapping is used. Native workbook Fahrenheit weather columns and seasonal weights are NOT model inputs; use GHCNh Celsius observations and training-only exposure weights.
